ratchet.reason: The <summary> of #nb-sub-section is 18px tall on a desktop, under the 24px of WCAG 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum), level AA. It is fine under a coarse pointer at every width, because the token layer keys the desktop override on `hover: hover` and coarse devices keep the phone numbers -- which is rule R1 already done right. What is missing is the other half: the fine axis has no floor of its own, `--tap` resolves to `auto` there, and 24px is a floor for every pointer and not only for a finger. P1 gives the mouse its own number instead of leaving it at 'intrinsic height'.
